lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He sits among the shadows of the stone,
With heavy hands and a heart of wood,
He carves the truth of every grain alone,
In a workshop where the ancient spirits stood.
[Pre-Chorus]
He looks at the chisel in his grip,
Watching the spark of his spirit slip.
[Chorus]
The wood holds the secrets of the land,
A story in every curve and line,
The master’s work is a steady hand,
Where the earth and the human heart entwine.
[Verse]
The apprentice watches the shavings fall like gold,
Each stroke a word in a silent prayer,
He finds the courage that the timber holds,
And feels the weight of the truth they share.
[Pre-Chorus]
The dust begins to dance in the light,
Turning the gray into colors so bright.
[Chorus]
The wood holds the secrets of the land,
A story in every curve and line,
The master’s work is a steady hand,
Where the earth and the human heart entwine.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
One spark becomes a flame within the grain,
A lifetime of seeking, now broken by pain.
[Chorus]
The wood holds the secrets of the land,
A story in every curve and line,
The master’s work is a steady hand,
Where the earth and the human heart entwine.
[Outro]
